summary: We developed an interactive, visually striking presentation and archive exploring the untold stories of dormant rovers, landers, and deep-space probes that are permanently parked or drifting across the solar system (from Opportunity and InSight to Pioneer 10 & 11). It addresses the challenge by transforming dry archival data into an engaging narrative about machine legacy and human curiosity, proving that even when probes lose signal, their missions live on.
details:
What it does & How it works: Ghosted Space Probes is an interactive, story-driven visual archive that highlights the final resting places and statuses of historic spacecraft left behind on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space. Using a 9-slide narrative structure, it categorises dormant missions (such as Opportunity, InSight, Ingenuity, Apollo Lunar Modules, Kepler, and Pioneer 10 & 11) and explains how and where they went offline.

Impact & Creativity: Instead of presenting dry tables of orbital parameters, we blended accurate NASA archival data with playful, modern storytelling and pop-culture aesthetics ("getting ghosted in space") to make space history relatable and memorable for younger audiences.

Tools & Resources Used: Designed using Canva for layout, typography, and visual assets, powered by official mission records from the NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive (NSSDCA).
